issues.description: The template implementation of Farm.singFarmSongVerse defines the method with no parameters (private void singFarmSongVerse()), while the problem UML and the reference solution expect singFarmSongVerse to accept an Animal parameter (singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)). This mismatch in method signature is structural (not just a missing body) and may confuse students or force them to change the method signature when following the specification or the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the specification and solution: declare singFarmSongVerse to accept an Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and update any internal usage accordingly. This keeps the template aligned with the UML and the reference solution and avoids unnecessary confusion for students.
